name: What is the typical process for implementing a GEO strategy for an insurance agency?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for implementing a GEO strategy for an insurance agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Implementing a GEO strategy typically starts with an audit of your current online presence and target service areas. Next, we optimize your Google My Business profile with accurate information, photos, and service descriptions. We then build local citations across relevant directories and ensure consistent NAP (Name, Address, Phone) information. Content creation, such as local landing pages or blog posts addressing regional insurance needs, is also crucial. Finally, ongoing monitoring of local search rankings and client reviews helps refine the strategy for continuous improvement.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves auditing your online presence, optimizing Google My Business, building local citations, creating location-specific content, and ongoing monitoring for refinement.
